title: Speaking — Useful websites
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on useful websites.

questions: Where do you usually spend time with friends?
How do you keep in touch with friends you rarely see?
What kinds of activities do you normally do together?
Do you prefer meeting one friend or a group?
What information do you often look for online?
Do you have a favourite website for learning something?

part2.topic: Describe an online resource that saved you time on a task.
part2.closing: and explain why you would use it again.

questions: What makes instructions on public service websites useful to everyone?
How should people decide whether to pay for an online learning tool?
How has everyday life connected with useful websites changed for people of different ages?
